subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 26, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 26, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS community,

We're excited to bring you the latest news and updates from the world of AcreetionOS. As we continue to work towards making our distribution the go-to choice for those seeking a user-friendly, privacy-focused Linux experience, we're thrilled to share some recent developments that highlight our commitment to innovation and community engagement.

In the news, BetaNews has featured AcreetionOS as the easy-to-use alternative to Windows 10/11, praising our user-friendly interface and seamless transition from Windows. This recognition is a testament to the hard work put in by our team to create a distribution that's both accessible and powerful.

Shelly 3.1.5, a GUI package manager for Arch Linux, has also made headlines with its recent update, which includes an Atoll-powered AUR browser. This feature expansion is a significant step forward for Arch Linux users, and we're excited to see the impact it will have on the community.

ZDNET has also weighed in on the Linux scene, listing AcreetionOS as one of the top alternatives to Omarchy for users looking for a change. This recognition is a great reminder that our distribution is not only a viable option but also a preferred choice for those seeking a more private and secure experience.

In addition to these external recognitions, we've been hard at work on our own projects. Our team has been busy fixing issues and pushing out updates to ensure that our distribution remains stable and secure. A recent commit to our codebase fixed a Discord newsletter push issue caused by Cloudflare blocking urllib's UA, and we've also made improvements to our Atom feed generation process.

We're also excited to announce that two stable kernels will be released this Friday, bringing even more stability and performance to our distribution. Additionally, a summary from the 2026 Git Contributors' Summit has been shared, highlighting the collaborative spirit and innovative ideas that drive our community forward.

Security updates are also on the horizon, with a batch of patches and fixes ready to be deployed. We take the security of our users very seriously, and we're committed to keeping our distribution up-to-date with the latest security patches.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we're grateful for the support of our community. Your feedback, suggestions, and contributions are invaluable to us, and we look forward to seeing what the future holds for AcreetionOS.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS family. We'll be back with more updates soon.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
